title: Unit 408 dining area: three Opus directions (D, E, F)
overview: Three dining area directions for Unit 408: DIND Midnight Velvet, DINE Heritage Persian and DINF Pale Oak and Rush.
requirements: All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles and decor; no model or family repeats across the schemes or the parallel sets.
Every piece fits the measured room with clear walkways and door swings; plans use published dimensions and flag the rest.
Seating, tables and storage are real catalogue products with a supplier photo, price and source link.
procurement_gates: Prices are catalogue references with each line's own price date. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.
Pieces flagged "dims unpublished" in the room placement report keep the layout size; measure them at the showroom before ordering.
Delivery path for the sofa, dining table and buffet (lift, corridor, door widths) to be confirmed with the building before ordering.
Style renders are AI interpretations painted over the dimension-led model views; supplier photo boards, measured plans and the item schedule are the acceptance basis.

schemes.title: Midnight Velvet
schemes.rationale: a smoked dark oak table on slab legs with six navy velvet chairs with woven backs, a cream rug drawn in fine brown diamonds, a navy sideboard under a navy-and-sand abstract in the counter-to-arch corner, a split-leaf philodendron in the window corner
fit_notes: Conditional fit: the layout rests on assumed values with a stated basis, none site-measured: ceiling 2700, window sills 900 and heads 2350, the arch about 1400 wide with its head at 2200 and 370 from the north corner, the pass-through counter 1050 and head 1550, the passage to the master bedroom 1566, the fan centred over the table. Drawn or photo-fixed: 3680 wide, 4468 deep, south window 3558 in four lights; the west wall has no window (Ivan, 23 Oct). See ASSUMED.md.
Table 1600 x 850 centred 2750 from the counter wall: 1040 clear from each table end to the side walls; six seats as 2 + 2 + 1 + 1.

Sideboard 1200 x 380 on the plain north wall between the arch and the pass-through (Ivan 23 Oct: the corner between counter and arch gets furniture or shelves); about 1.35 m stays clear between its front and the tucked north chairs for the arch-to-passage lane.
Rug 8'x10' (2438 x 3048) laid long side to the window: about 316 to each side wall; every tucked chair stands on it.

No pendant (the fan stays); split unit high on the east wall over the table; Davies Beige blackout + voile with valance boards on the south window. The old window unit stays hidden behind the curtains (Ivan 23 Oct), so the views leave it out.
schemes.table: 1600 x 850, the current proposal (not yet approved); long side parallel to the south window, centre 2750 from the counter wall
